description: This file defines an internal interface for the Orleans runtime related to silo manifest system target, including a method to retrieve the silo manifest.

classes.name: ISiloManifestSystemTarget
classes.description: An internal interface within Orleans.Runtime for silo manifest system target, inheriting from ISystemTarget and providing a method to asynchronously retrieve the silo's manifest.

methods.name: GetSiloManifest
methods.description: An asynchronous method returning a ValueTask containing the GrainManifest for the silo.
